children: Oil rises in early Asian trade amid attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway for oil transportation. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said that "two non-compliant" oil tankers struck mines in the strait, ANZ Research analysts say in a report. "At least 18 vessels have been hit over the past two weeks, according to ship tracking data from Kpler," the analysts add. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are up 0.7% at $93.52 a barrel, while front-month Brent crude oil futures are 0.7% higher at $109.54 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
